payload.head_surface: strainer
payload.tail_surface: consider a strainer on the suction side of a positive displacement pump
payload.evidence_text: It is always good practice to consider a strainer on the suction side of a positive displacement pump. The strainer will keep foreign objects from going into the pump.

payload.head_surface: relief valve
payload.tail_surface: mounting one in the discharge line
conditions: If the pump is not equipped with a relief valve
payload.evidence_text: If the pump is not equipped with a relief valve, consideration should be given to mounting one in the discharge line.

payload.head_surface: foot valve
payload.tail_surface: at the end of the suction piping
conditions: When pumping a light liquid with a suction lift
payload.evidence_text: When pumping a light liquid with a suction lift, a foot valve at the end of the suction piping or a check valve in the first horizontal run will hold the liquid in the line and make it easier for the pump to prime.

payload.head_surface: pipe sealer
payload.tail_surface: All joints of the piping system should be tight; pipe sealer will help assure leak-free threaded joints
payload.evidence_text: All joints of the piping system should be tight; pipe sealer will help assure leak-free threaded joints.

payload.head_surface: bypass should be built around the strainer, or two strainers should be put in parallel with proper valving so they can be isolated for cleaning
payload.evidence_text: If the pump operates continuously, a bypass should be built around the strainer, or two strainers should be put in parallel with proper valving so they can be isolated for cleaning.

payload.head_surface: Loops, expansion joints, or unsecured (this does not mean unsupported) runs should be used
conditions: When piping a hot or cold system (liquid being handled is at a temperature different from the air surrounding the pump)
payload.evidence_text: When piping a hot or cold system (liquid being handled is at a temperature different from the air surrounding the pump), be sure allowance is made for expansion and contraction of the piping. Loops, expansion joints, or unsecured (this does not mean unsupported) runs should be used so the pump casing is not distorted.
